name: ScoutRAG Bundesliga 2023/2024 retrieval seed
labeling_method: Rule-assisted manual seed: exact and team labels use typed metadata; trait labels use Phase 3 source-comparable position percentiles and were reviewed against the generated profiles.
limitations: This is a small portfolio seed, not an independent multi-annotator relevance study.
The source partition contains Bayer Leverkusen's full season while opponent teams, including Bayern Munich, have partial match coverage.
Bayern queries therefore evaluate identity, team, position, and lexical recall rather than full-season statistical superiority.
Unlisted players are treated as non-relevant for the current seed and may be revised in later dataset versions.
